plugin.note: Melee Infernal Mages in the north-east room on the first floor of the Slayer Tower. Use your best owned melee equipment and a Slayer helmet or black mask on task. Protect from Magic (37 Prayer) blocks their magic attacks; bring prayer restoration and food. Cannons cannot be used in the tower.

mechanics: Infernal Mages have 60 Hitpoints, a max hit of 8 and a 4-tick Magic attack. Their Magic level is 75, Defence level 60, and defensive bonuses are 0 against melee/ranged and +40 against Magic. No elemental weakness is listed.
Protect from Magic negates their attacks. They are immune to weak burns.
The superior encounter is the Malevolent Mage; it is not a separately selectable repeatable setup.
No task extension unlock is listed. Mortimer can offer a quantity modifier.
Completed Morytania Diary tiers grant 2.5%, 5%, 7.5% or 10% bonus Slayer experience in the tower.

methods.label: Ordinary melee task
methods.summary: Melee Infernal Mages in the north-east room on the first floor of the Slayer Tower. Use your best owned melee equipment and a Slayer helmet or black mask on task. Protect from Magic (37 Prayer) blocks their magic attacks; bring prayer restoration and food. Cannons cannot be used in the tower.
steps: Use the best owned melee weapon and strength equipment available. The general Slayer training guide recommends an Abyssal whip or stronger alternatives with a defender when the weapon permits one.
Both regular and imbued Slayer helmets or black masks provide their melee task bonus. A Slayer helmet also protects against Banshees and Aberrant spectres on access routes; a black mask does not.

At 37 Prayer or higher, Protect from Magic prevents their incoming damage. Bring prayer potions or super restores to sustain it, and food for emergencies. Without the prayer, expect accurate Magic attacks and take enough food.
Fight individual mages in their first-floor room. They are not aggressive, and the tower does not allow a cannon.
notes: Equipment priorities come from the general Slayer training melee table because Infernal Mage has no dedicated equipment or strategy page. Owned lower-tier alternatives remain eligible through the normal fallback selection.
Infernal Mages occupy one tile. The general guide's multi-hit Scythe advice for larger monsters does not establish it as the best weapon for this target.

methods.label: Slayer Tower (first floor)
methods.summary: Travel to the north-east room one level above the ground floor; routing targets the Infernal Mage spawns.
steps: Infernal Mages are found only in the Slayer Tower, in the north-east room on the first floor (one level above ground). The Wiki lists 15 spawn tiles.
A Slayer ring teleports to the entrance. Alternatives include fairy ring CKS south of the tower, Salve Graveyard Teleport, or Kharyrll teleport to Canifis, then running north-west.

Fenkenstrain's Castle Teleport followed by a run west, an Ectophial followed by a longer walk, or walking through Paterdomus are further alternatives. Shortest Path checks available transports and their unlocks.
Use the south-east stairs. The normal ground-floor route passes Banshees, so wear Earmuffs or a Slayer helmet while passing them; the eastern broken-window shortcut at 18 Agility avoids that route.

The 61 Agility spiked chain reaches the Aberrant spectre room instead. Wear a Nose peg or Slayer helmet if taking that route; 60 Slayer is needed to equip a Nose peg, not to use the stairs to Infernal Mages.
Cannons are prohibited throughout the Slayer Tower. The Infernal Mage page does not document a safespot; their Magic attacks can still reach ranged attackers.
